concepts.definition: Total assets the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, being the sum of current and non-current assets. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars, not a current attribute and not evidence of company scale.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds a charity balance-sheet total; ext.financial.total_income is an income measure owned by business, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: Total current assets the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars, distinct from total assets and from non-current assets.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a charity's current-asset balance; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned income measure, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: Total non-current assets the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars, distinct from current assets and from the residual 'other non-current assets' line.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a charity's non-current-asset balance; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned income measure, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: The residual 'other non-current assets' amount the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, i.e. non-current assets not itemised in the named breakdown lines. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars; it is a component of, not a substitute for, total non-current assets.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds a residual non-current-asset line; dyn.charity.total_non_current_assets (proposed) is the aggregate and reuse would change meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: Total liabilities the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, being the sum of current and non-current liabilities. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars, not a tax payable figure.
concepts.why_not_existing: ext.financial.tax_payable is a business-owned tax liability for a period, not a charity's total liabilities; reuse would change meaning, owner and scope.

concepts.definition: Total current liabilities the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars, distinct from total liabilities and from non-current liabilities.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a charity's current-liability balance; ext.financial.tax_payable is a business-owned tax amount, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: Total non-current liabilities the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars, distinct from current liabilities and from the residual 'other non-current liabilities' line.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers a charity's non-current-liability balance; ext.financial.tax_payable is a business-owned tax amount, so reuse would change meaning, owner and units.

concepts.definition: The residual 'other non-current liabilities' amount the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, i.e. non-current liabilities not itemised in the named breakdown lines. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars; it is a component of, not a substitute for, total non-current liabilities.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds a residual non-current-liability line; dyn.charity.total_non_current_liabilities (proposed) is the aggregate and reuse would change meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: The amount of non-current loans payable the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars owed by the charity; a reported zero is retained as published and is not evidence of no borrowings.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers charity borrowings; ext.financial.tax_payable is a business-owned tax amount and dyn.charity.total_non_current_liabilities (proposed) is the aggregate, so reuse would change meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: The amount of non-current loans receivable the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars owed to the charity; a reported zero is retained as published and is not evidence of no lending.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept covers charity loans receivable; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned income measure and dyn.charity.total_non_current_assets (proposed) is the aggregate, so reuse would change meaning and granularity.

concepts.definition: Net assets or net liabilities the charity reports in its ACNC Annual Information Statement for its own financial reporting period, i.e. total assets less total liabilities as published. A period-specific balance-sheet amount in Australian dollars; a negative value denotes net liabilities and is not a deficit for the period.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds a charity's net asset position; ext.financial.total_income is a business-owned income measure and net surplus/deficit is a period result, not a balance-sheet residual, so reuse would change meaning.

concepts.definition: Free-text narrative supplied by the charity in its ACNC Annual Information Statement describing its assets and liabilities for the reporting period. Self-reported narrative retained verbatim; amounts mentioned inside the text are illustrative and are not structured financial facts.
concepts.why_not_existing: No shortlisted concept holds charity-owned free-text describing its balance sheet; dyn.charity.purposes_pursued_description and dyn.charity.international_activity_details are narratives about activities, so reuse would change meaning.

reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_period_star: Reused as the period qualifier for all balance-sheet amounts in this group; the charity's own reporting period start date.
reuse.dyn.charity.financial_report_period_end: Reused as the period qualifier for all balance-sheet amounts in this group; the charity's own reporting period end date.
reuse.dyn.charity.accounting_basis: Reused as context for interpreting the reported balance-sheet amounts (cash vs accrual basis).
reuse.dyn.charity.report_consolidated_flag: Reused as context: consolidated reports may include more than one entity, so balance-sheet amounts are not necessarily single-entity.
